en: Black-and-white aerial photograph of a small rural town with scattered detached houses, a few larger apartment-style buildings in the foreground, grid-like dirt or lightly paved streets, surrounding fields, forested patches, a railway line running parallel to the edge of a lake on the right, and flat countryside stretching into the distance. No visible text or caption appears on the image.
